option_relations.rationale: The option and leaf both refer to Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
Dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa (particularly DEB pruriginosa) is a subtype of Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
Epidermolysis bullosa pruriginosa (EBP) is a subtype of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa, which is related to Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
Recessive dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa is a different condition than Dominant Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa.
